dimensions.fix: Approve or auto-approve (earned autonomy) the first replies; run om-lead-to-sale on every daemon cycle that finds new leads.

dimensions.fix: Feed state/agent-outcomes.json into om-evolve: improve or retire agents whose items reach the market without results, copy the playbooks of agents that sell.

dimensions.fix: Route work by results: the mega heads delegate to specialists with outcome credit first; agents unused for 90 days become candidates to merge.
